title: Xp Bottler
description: XP Bottler: Convert your XP levels into storable bottles.
body:
### XP Bottler
Turn your hard-earned experience levels into storable and reusable XP bottles!

## Key Features
- 🎯 Level-to-Bottle Conversion

Use /trigger store_xp set <value> to convert a specific number of levels into an XP bottle.

**Example:** /trigger store_xp set 10 creates a bottle containing exactly 10 levels.

- 💥 Convert All Your XP at Once

Use /trigger Store_All_LVL to instantly convert all your XP into a single, high-capacity bottle.

Perfect for quick storage before dangerous adventures!

## 🔄 XP Recovery System

Consuming a bottle instantly restores the exact levels it contains, making XP transfer simple and precise.

## 🌍 100% Vanilla & Multiplayer-Friendly

- Works in pure vanilla Minecraft, no mods required.
- Fully compatible with multiplayer servers.

## 💡 Use Cases

- Safely store XP before risky battles
- Transport experience between bases or dimensions
- Share XP easily with other players
